movement.interpretation: Positive association means higher ZAI_WIN aligns with increasing normalized market share; descriptive, not causal or incremental-predictive proof.
movement.weights: 1/n_active for each runner, equal total weight per race
movement.x: ZAI_WIN race-standardized after explicit nonstarter removal

notes: Existing per_index implementation and 1000/200 resampling are reused; Holm resolution remains insufficient at 200.
VMI is a market-derived descriptive control; no weights, Production inputs or artifacts are modified.
Private raw capture files are needed to reproduce this report; public numeric metadata alone is not silently accepted.

multiple_testing.limitation: 200 plus-one shuffle p values cannot resolve p<=0.05/13; the 200 runs remain descriptive controls.
